purpose: These three sequences separate the three put conflict modes and the three channel definitions. Experiment 1 distinguishes INSERT OR IGNORE (second put changes nothing) from INSERT OR REPLACE and ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE (second put changes the row). Experiment 2 distinguishes INSERT OR REPLACE from ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE under rollback: REPLACE deletes the old row and inserts a new one, so rollback restores the original row; DO UPDATE modifies the existing row, so rollback also restores the original row, but the channel counts differ. Experiment 3 distinguishes the same two modes under commit: REPLACE deletes and inserts, DO UPDATE updates in place, and the channel counts differ. Together with the trigger and total_changes variants, these experiments separate all 18 family members.
